title: Seoul Korean restaurants: 9 places from fine dining to market food
desc: A map of Korean restaurants in Seoul grouped into fine dining and royal cuisine, Korean BBQ and beef, and soups, noodles and market food.

items.title: Mingles (밍글스)
items.memo: Modern Korean tasting menus, Michelin-recognized through 2026.

items.title: Jungsik (정식당)
items.memo: Tasting menus from about 180,000 won; one of Korea's best-known fine dining names.

items.title: Jihwaja (지화자)
items.memo: Royal court cuisine such as gujeolpan, about 50,000-80,000 won per person.

items.title: Samwon Garden (삼원가든)
items.memo: Hanwoo in a traditional setting with gardens; upscale, 80,000-150,000 won pp.

items.title: Byeokje Galbi (벽제갈비)
items.memo: Upscale hanwoo with expert butchering and grilling guidance.

items.title: Maple Tree House (Itaewon)
items.memo: Mid-range pork and beef BBQ without Gangnam's premium prices.

items.title: Tosokchon Samgyetang (토속촌 삼계탕)
items.memo: Ginseng chicken soup; expect queues on summer boknal days.

items.title: Myeongdong Kyoja (명동교자)
items.memo: Kalguksu, hand-cut noodle soup, around 10,000 won a bowl.

items.title: Gwangjang Market (광장시장)
items.memo: Bindaetteok and mayak gimbap for 3,000-8,000 won.
